subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server reply-session-init conflict leaves the session with no transcript mirror → tool-results silently return empty with no self-heal

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR's runtime/harness self-heal boundary for this reply-session conflict after live or integration proof, or require a narrower recovery design?
rationale: Source inspection proves the current gap, but whether the proposed reset boundary is safe enough needs maintainer judgment plus runtime proof across session state and Codex binding behavior.

options.title: Require proof on the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 adds redacted live/log or integration proof that the session recovers and tool results are non-empty.

options.title: Ask for a narrower design
options.body: Pause the linked PR and require a smaller recovery boundary if resetting MCP runtime plus harness bindings is considered too broad for the conflict branch.

options.title: Open a replacement only if needed
options.body: If the linked PR closes or cannot be proven, queue a new focused fix from this issue rather than leaving the report unowned.

recommendation.title: Require proof on the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 adds redacted live/log or integration proof that the session recovers and tool results are non-empty.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex binding-state ownership makes this the best available person for the recovery-boundary decision.
